candidates.label: Earth's final earthquake discharging burdens and reporting news by divine command
candidates.definition: In 99:1-5: When the earth is shaken with its final earthquake and the earth discharges its burdens and man says what is wrong with it; that Day it will report its news because your Lord has commanded it.

candidates.label: Separated departure to witness deeds with atom-weight precision
candidates.definition: In 99:6-8: That Day the people will depart separated into categories to be shown the result of their deeds; so whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
